_about: Voice clips (Japanese, from the game) played when her expression changes, grouped by expression. Each entry is a file in voices/ and the English line it says.

default.gain.ogg: Hmm... a new Commander? How long will you pique my interest, we shall see~
default.hello.ogg: Is that you, Commander? I didn't even have to look.
default.dialoguewedding.ogg: ...Hmm? Commander, are you peeking at me? Why not do it openly? We're used to each other by now, right?

happy.valentine.ogg: That AN-94 forced this chocolate on me. Ah, Commander, are you hungry? I've got sweets.
happy.tanabata.ogg: I don't remember what I wished for. More importantly, let's go to the festival already.
happy.allhallows.ogg: What is it? Ah, it's just candy. Ah, look over there! There's a shrine maiden!

neutral.dialogue1.ogg: To avoid wasting processing power, I usually keep my eyes shut. Don't worry, it doesn't affect my sight or judgment.
neutral.dialogue2.ogg: There's no need for everyone to push themselves so hard. After all, not everyone was chosen like me.
neutral.feed.ogg: A performance upgrade is wasted without tactical understanding.
neutral.combine.ogg: Dummies can't compare to my performance. I'll have to rely on myself, of course.
neutral.operationbegin.ogg: Missions like this don't need any deep computation.

question.dialogue3.ogg: Hmm? Why are you being sneaky, Commander? Is something interesting happening?
question.buildover.ogg: A new employee? Hurry up and introduce yourself!
question.newyear.ogg: Hatsumode? I'll pass. I already went.
question.formation.ogg: If only that person were here too...

serious.goattack.ogg: Time to get serious. Mission start.
